name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain render, descriptor hp_or_mp_bar_proportional. No address residue (0x65/0x14 are layout/probe constants, not in the name). Accurately reflects purpose confirmed by both callers: it computes a proportional fill-segment count and dispatches the HP (sprite_base 0x17) or MP (0x1A) bar.
purpose: Compute a proportional fill-segment count from current/max and dispatch to fd2_render_horizontal_bar_segments to paint an HP or MP bar.
logic_summary: If max==0 return without drawing (div-by-zero guard; absent stat draws no bar). Else if current==0 segments=0 (fully empty bar). Else segments=(current*0x65)/max + 1. The binary does a SIGNED multiply/divide (IMUL EDX,[current],0x65 / MOV EAX,EDX / SAR EDX,0x1F / IDIV [max] / INC EAX), so src performs the arithmetic with signed int32 operands to match. 0x65 (101) is the max fillable segment count (reached at current==max); the +1 guarantees a 1-segment minimum sliver for any non-zero current (so '1 HP left' still shows a visible bar). Finally calls fd2_render_horizontal_bar_segments(dst_off, pitch, segments, sprite_base).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_hp_or_mp_bar_proportional(uint32 dst_off, uint32 pitch, uint32 sprite_base, uint32 current, uint32 max)

params.semantics: Destination buffer byte-offset where the bar starts (caller passes overlay_buffer+0x2A06 for HP, +0x41C6 for MP in the full panel; buf+stride*0x16+0x15 / +stride*0x1F+0x15 in the mini panel). Forwarded unchanged as arg1 of fd2_render_horizontal_bar_segments.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Destination surface stride/pitch in bytes (0x140 from the full panel; the caller-supplied stride from the mini panel). Forwarded unchanged as arg2 of fd2_render_horizontal_bar_segments.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Base sprite-sheet index selecting the bar color theme: 0x17 = HP (red), 0x1A = MP (blue). Forwarded unchanged as arg4 (sprite_base) of fd2_render_horizontal_bar_segments.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_3; src already uses sprite_base. Stage-2 rename to sprite_base.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Current stat value (HP_current or MP_current), the numerator. It is the IMUL multiplicand (current*0x65); when 0 the fully-empty branch (segments=0) is taken. NOT a buffer pointer.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name dst_buf is actively misleading (Stack[0x10] ordinal 3 is the current stat value, not a destination buffer) and is wrongly typed byte*; src already declares it uint32 current. Stage-2 rename to current.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Maximum stat value (HP_max or MP_max), the denominator. It is the IDIV divisor and the operand of the div-by-zero guard (max==0 returns without drawing). NOT a surface stride.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name stride is actively misleading (Stack[0x14] ordinal 4 is the max stat / IDIV divisor, not the surface stride which is param_2); src already declares it uint32 max. Stage-2 rename to max.

returns.semantics: No return value; either returns early (max==0) or dispatches to fd2_render_horizontal_bar_segments which renders into the destination surface.
